text:
Sandy Spring Bank decreased its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.2% during the fourth its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 152,052 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,867 shares during the period. Apple makes up 2.3% of Sandy Spring Bank’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 6th largest holding. Sandy Spring Bank’s holdings in Apple were worth $25,731,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Shares of Apple opened at $188.58 on Friday, according to MarketBeat . The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37. The firm has a market capitalization of $956.86 billion, a PE ratio of 20.48, a PEG ratio of 1.40 and a beta of 1.26. Apple has a 1 year low of $142.20 and a 1 year high of $190.37. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business earned $2.10 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has authorized a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are usually an indication that the company’s board believes its shares are undervalued.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, May 17th. Investors of record on Monday, May 14th were given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This is a positive change from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, May 11th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.55%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 31.70%.
